entries.label: katana
entries.body: Katana
entries.source: Katana
entries.translation: 卡塔納

entries.label: HOSTILE_KATANA_1
entries.body:
I, Katana the Warrior, have travelled for long years through space, finally to come home
only to witness you blasting my brother to atoms!
Now you die!
entries.source:
I, Katana the Warrior, have travelled for long years through space, finally to come home
only to witness you blasting my brother to atoms!
Now you die!
entries.translation:
我，武士卡塔納， 長年橫越太空，歷盡漂泊， 終於歸返故土
竟親眼看見你把我兄弟轟成 原子！
如今受死吧！

entries.label: HOSTILE_KATANA_2
entries.body:
The Ur-Quan has returned! How unusually brave
for a leprous, non-functional sex organ, like yourself.
entries.source:
The Ur-Quan has returned! How unusually brave
for a leprous, non-functional sex organ, like yourself.
entries.translation:
烏爾關又回來了！ 這份勇氣還真是罕見
對像你這種麻瘋潰爛、 毫無用處的生殖器來說。

entries.label: HOSTILE_KATANA_3
entries.body:
Evil murderer, you think to taunt me.
Ha! And again I say, Ha!
I have faced far worse than you
You pitiful imitation of six-weeks dead Dhrang!
entries.source:
Evil murderer, you think to taunt me.
Ha! And again I say, Ha!
I have faced far worse than you
You pitiful imitation of six-weeks dead Dhrang!
entries.translation:
邪惡的殺人凶手， 你以為能激怒我。
哈！我再說一次，哈！
遠比你可怕的敵人， 我都曾面對
你不過是死了六星期的德朗 之可悲仿冒品！

entries.label: HOSTILE_KATANA_4
entries.body: I swear by the hero, Daikon, this time I will kill you.
entries.source: I swear by the hero, Daikon, this time I will kill you.
entries.translation: 我以英雄大根之名發誓， 這次一定取你性命。

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_1
entries.body:
Attention huge alien vessel!
Though most of my sensory instruments are malfunctioning
my mass indicator shows the huge size of your vessel
revealing you are none other
than a disgusting Ur-Quan slimewad!
I am the glorious Shofixti warrior Tanaka.
You killed my father... my mother... my many brothers
all six of my sisters
in fact, my entire species.
Prepare to die!
entries.source:
Attention huge alien vessel!
Though most of my sensory instruments are malfunctioning
my mass indicator shows the huge size of your vessel
revealing you are none other
than a disgusting Ur-Quan slimewad!
I am the glorious Shofixti warrior Tanaka.
You killed my father... my mother... my many brothers
all six of my sisters
in fact, my entire species.
Prepare to die!
entries.translation:
巨大外星船艦，注意！
雖然我大部分的感測儀器都 已故障
但質量指示器顯示你的船艦 體型無比巨大
這揭露了你的真面目
你正是噁心的烏爾關黏液渣 滓！
我是榮耀的索菲克斯提武士 田中。
你殺了我父親……我母 親……我眾多兄弟
還有我六個姊妹
事實上，是我的整個物種。
準備受死！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_2
entries.body:
Ah, so the cowardly slug-spawn has returned!
You were most fortunate last time, you hideous, pouchless freak!
But this time I shall surely destroy your vessel
you slithering eater of putrid hairballs!
entries.source:
Ah, so the cowardly slug-spawn has returned!
You were most fortunate last time, you hideous, pouchless freak!
But this time I shall surely destroy your vessel
you slithering eater of putrid hairballs!
entries.translation:
啊，膽小的蛞蝓孽種又回來 了！
上次算你走運，你這醜陋、 沒育兒袋的怪胎！
但這次我必定摧毀你的船艦
你這條蠕動著吞食腐臭毛球 的爬蟲！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_3
entries.body: I see you're back for even more humiliation, you flatulent, Ur-Quan pus-cup.
entries.source: I see you're back for even more humiliation, you flatulent, Ur-Quan pus-cup.
entries.translation: 看來你又回來自取其辱了， 你這放屁不止的烏爾關膿 杯。

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_4
entries.body: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.source: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.translation: 這次我定要殺了你， 你這可悲軟弱、 專愛群居牲畜糞便的傢伙！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_5
entries.body: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.source: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.translation: 這次我定要殺了你， 你這可悲軟弱、 專愛群居牲畜糞便的傢伙！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_6
entries.body: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.source: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.translation: 這次我定要殺了你， 你這可悲軟弱、 專愛群居牲畜糞便的傢伙！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_7
entries.body: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.source: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.translation: 這次我定要殺了你， 你這可悲軟弱、 專愛群居牲畜糞便的傢伙！

entries.label: HOSTILE_TANAKA_8
entries.body: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.source: I'll kill you this time you pitiful, weakling fancier of herd animal excrement!
entries.translation: 這次我定要殺了你， 你這可悲軟弱、 專愛群居牲畜糞便的傢伙！

entries.label: dont_attack
entries.body: Don't attack -- we're not the Ur-Quan! We're your allies!
entries.source: Don't attack -- we're not the Ur-Quan! We're your allies!
entries.translation: 別攻擊——我們不是烏爾 關！我們是你的盟友！

entries.label: TYPICAL_PLOY
entries.body:
A typical Ur-Quan gambit... which has failed.
And now I howl the scream of death!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
A typical Ur-Quan gambit... which has failed.
And now I howl the scream of death!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
烏爾關慣用的伎倆…… 但這次失敗了。
現在，我要嘶吼出死亡的尖 嘯！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: hey_stop
entries.body: Hey, stop shooting! Someone could get hurt!
entries.source: Hey, stop shooting! Someone could get hurt!
entries.translation: 嘿，別再開火了！ 這樣會有人受傷！

entries.label: ONLY_STOP
entries.body:
I will only stop when you are dead!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
I will only stop when you are dead!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
除非你死，否則我絕不停 手！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: look_you_are
entries.body: Look, you're getting me REALLY pissed-off!  Stop attacking and talk!
entries.source: Look, you're getting me REALLY pissed-off!  Stop attacking and talk!
entries.translation: 聽著，你真的把我惹火了！  停止攻擊，開口談談！

entries.label: TOO_BAD
entries.body:
Too bad.
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Too bad.
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
太可惜了。
喝呀咿！

entries.label: dont_know
entries.body: Don't you know the war is over?
entries.source: Don't you know the war is over?
entries.translation: 你不知道戰爭已經結束了 嗎？

entries.label: NEVER
entries.body:
For me it will never be over!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
For me it will never be over!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
對我來說永遠不會結束！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: look0
entries.body: Look
entries.source: Look
entries.translation: 聽著

entries.label: look1
entries.body: , the war is over -- really!
entries.source: , the war is over -- really!
entries.translation: ，戰爭真的已經結束了！

entries.label: FOR_YOU
entries.body:
For you perhaps, fat cowardly lard-log!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
For you perhaps, fat cowardly lard-log!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
或許對你來說是吧， 你這肥胖膽小的油脂木樁！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: no_bloodshed
entries.body: There is no point in further bloodshed.
entries.source: There is no point in further bloodshed.
entries.translation: 繼續流血毫無意義。

entries.label: YES_BLOODSHED
entries.body:
Oh yes there is!
When you have shed enough blood, You Will Die!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Oh yes there is!
When you have shed enough blood, You Will Die!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
當然有意義！
等你流了夠多的血， 你就會死！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: dont_want_to_fight
entries.body: Gee, if that's the way you feel, then I'll be on my way.
entries.source: Gee, if that's the way you feel, then I'll be on my way.
entries.translation: 好吧，你既然這麼想， 那我就先走了。

entries.label: MUST_FIGHT_YOU_URQUAN_1
entries.body:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
休想逃走！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: MUST_FIGHT_YOU_URQUAN_2
entries.body:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
休想逃走！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: MUST_FIGHT_YOU_URQUAN_3
entries.body:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
休想逃走！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: MUST_FIGHT_YOU_URQUAN_4
entries.body:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
Oh no you don't!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
休想逃走！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: no_one_insults
entries.body: No one insults us like that you toothless, piebald, impotent roof-rabbit!
entries.source: No one insults us like that you toothless, piebald, impotent roof-rabbit!
entries.translation: 沒人可以這樣侮辱我們， 你這沒牙、花斑、 陽痿的屋頂兔！

entries.label: YOU_LIMP
entries.body:
You limp, bloodless sack of decaying flesh Ur-Quan! You die!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
You limp, bloodless sack of decaying flesh Ur-Quan! You die!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
烏爾關，你這癱軟無血的腐 肉袋！受死吧！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: mighty_words
entries.body: Those are mighty words from a dripping, snout-rotted little furball!
entries.source: Those are mighty words from a dripping, snout-rotted little furball!
entries.translation: 一顆滴著黏液、 爛到鼻口的小毛球， 口氣倒挺大！

entries.label: HANG_YOUR
entries.body:
I will hang your withered reproductive organs from my posterior monitor!
Kyaiee!
entries.source:
I will hang your withered reproductive organs from my posterior monitor!
Kyaiee!
entries.translation:
我要把你枯萎的生殖器官掛 在我的艦尾監視器上！
喝呀咿！

entries.label: donkey_breath
entries.body: Look donkey breath - one more insult and it's vapor city for you!
entries.source: Look donkey breath - one more insult and it's vapor city for you!
entries.translation: 聽著，驢口臭——再侮辱一 句，我就把你轟成蒸氣！

entries.label: DGRUNTI
entries.body:
Why you wallowing, phlegm-filled Dgrunti belly-licker, you
hey
Ur-Quans never insulted me before!
Who did you say you were?
entries.source:
Why you wallowing, phlegm-filled Dgrunti belly-licker, you
hey
Ur-Quans never insulted me before!
Who did you say you were?
entries.translation:
你這在泥裡打滾、 滿肚濃痰、專舔德格朗蒂肚 皮的——
等等
烏爾關以前從沒侮辱過我！
你剛才說自己是誰？

entries.label: i_am_captain0
entries.body: I am Captain
entries.source: I am Captain
entries.translation: 我是

entries.label: i_am_captain1
entries.body: from the
entries.source: from the
entries.translation: 船長，隸屬於

entries.label: i_am_captain2
entries.body: aboard the flagship
entries.source: aboard the flagship
entries.translation: 並搭乘旗艦

entries.label: i_am_captain3
entries.body: . Cease aggression immediately!
entries.source: . Cease aggression immediately!
entries.translation: 。立刻停止攻擊！

entries.label: i_am_nice
entries.body: I am the nice, friendly ally WHO YOU'VE BEEN TRYING TO KILL -- YOU IDIOT, MORON RATHEAD!
entries.source: I am the nice, friendly ally WHO YOU'VE BEEN TRYING TO KILL -- YOU IDIOT, MORON RATHEAD!
entries.translation: 我是那個友善親切、 卻一直被你追殺的盟友—— 你這個白癡、低能的老鼠腦 袋！

entries.label: i_am_guy
entries.body: I am the guy who called you donkey-breath, you violent little varmint.
entries.source: I am the guy who called you donkey-breath, you violent little varmint.
entries.translation: 我就是剛才罵你驢口臭的那 個人，你這暴力的小害獸。

entries.label: SO_SORRY
entries.body:
Oh. I am sorriest
I must be reprimanded.
When we report back to Star Control...
entries.source:
Oh. I am sorriest
I must be reprimanded.
When we report back to Star Control...
entries.translation:
噢。我萬分抱歉
我必須受罰。
等我們回星際控制報到 時……

entries.label: MUST_UNDERSTAND
entries.body:
Hyai! What a fool I am!
When you failed to launch fighter craft, I should have guessed.
Just one of those mistakes you make in war...
entries.source:
Hyai! What a fool I am!
When you failed to launch fighter craft, I should have guessed.
Just one of those mistakes you make in war...
entries.translation:
嗨呀！我真是個蠢貨！
你沒有放出戰鬥機時， 我就該猜到了。
這不過是戰爭中偶爾會犯的 錯……

entries.label: NICE_BUT_WHAT_IS_DONKEY
entries.body:
Ah, Earth humor! Very funny! Ha-ha-ha!
But what is don...
entries.source:
Ah, Earth humor! Very funny! Ha-ha-ha!
But what is don...
entries.translation:
啊，地球式幽默！真好笑！ 哈哈哈！
可是「驢……」是什麼……

entries.label: IS_DEFEAT_TRUE
entries.body:
Suddenly your words ring in my ears.
Captain, is this true? Have the Ur-Quan been destroyed?
Has the ultimate sacrifice of my people resulted in freedom for the Alliance?
entries.source:
Suddenly your words ring in my ears.
Captain, is this true? Have the Ur-Quan been destroyed?
Has the ultimate sacrifice of my people resulted in freedom for the Alliance?
entries.translation:
你的話突然在我耳中迴盪。
船長，這是真的嗎？ 烏爾關已被消滅了嗎？
我族付出的終極犧牲， 是否為聯盟換來了自由？

entries.label: yes_and_no
entries.body: Well yes AND no... mostly no.
entries.source: Well yes AND no... mostly no.
entries.translation: 嗯，對也不對…… 主要是不對。

entries.label: butt_blasted
entries.body: I'm sorry to be the one to tell you, but the Alliance got its butt blasted.
entries.source: I'm sorry to be the one to tell you, but the Alliance got its butt blasted.
entries.translation: 很抱歉得由我告訴你， 但聯盟被人轟得屁滾尿流。

entries.label: clobbered
entries.body: Er... maybe we should talk about this later.
entries.source: Er... maybe we should talk about this later.
entries.translation: 呃……也許我們晚點再談這 件事。

entries.label: VERY_SAD_KILL_SELF
entries.body:
HYAIEEE!
I am a defeated warrior! A worthless shell!
I must die!!!!
entries.source:
HYAIEEE!
I am a defeated warrior! A worthless shell!
I must die!!!!
entries.translation:
喝呀咿——！
我是戰敗的武士！ 一具毫無價值的空殼！
我必須死！！！！

entries.label: important_duty
entries.body: No, wait, Shofixti! I have an important duty for you to perform.
entries.source: No, wait, Shofixti! I have an important duty for you to perform.
entries.translation: 不，等等，索菲克斯提！ 我有一項重要任務要交給 你。

entries.label: WHAT_DUTY
entries.body: What might that be?
entries.source: What might that be?
entries.translation: 那會是什麼任務？

entries.label: need_you_for_duty
entries.body: Shofixti, I am now your new commander. I order you not to kill yourself.  You are to remain here and guard your solar system.
entries.source: Shofixti, I am now your new commander. I order you not to kill yourself.  You are to remain here and guard your solar system.
entries.translation: 索菲克斯提，我現在是你的 新任指揮官。我命令你不得 自盡。  你要留在這裡， 守護你的星系。

entries.label: OK_WILL_BE_SENTRY
entries.body:
To fight again? Against the Ur-Quan?
Yes.  But no
I cannot leave my homeworld unguarded. I will remain here and keep a solitary vigil.
Goodbye.
entries.source:
To fight again? Against the Ur-Quan?
Yes.  But no
I cannot leave my homeworld unguarded. I will remain here and keep a solitary vigil.
Goodbye.
entries.translation:
要我再次奮戰？ 對抗烏爾關？
是。  但不行
我不能讓母星無人防守。 我會留在這裡，獨自守望。
再會。

entries.label: dont_do_it
entries.body: Don't do it, old Warrior! You still have much to live for!
entries.source: Don't do it, old Warrior! You still have much to live for!
entries.translation: 別這麼做，老武士！ 你的人生還有許多值得活下 去的事！

entries.label: YES_I_DO_IT
entries.body:
Like what?!
My race is dead. My world is an airless rock. And I've seen all my FunRoms at least a hundred times.
My life is over.
I have already picked out a nice asteroid to smash into
so if you don't mind, I'll just go and kill myself.
Unless you want to annihilate me yourself.
entries.source:
Like what?!
My race is dead. My world is an airless rock. And I've seen all my FunRoms at least a hundred times.
My life is over.
I have already picked out a nice asteroid to smash into
so if you don't mind, I'll just go and kill myself.
Unless you want to annihilate me yourself.
entries.translation:
比如什麼？！
我的種族滅亡了。 我的世界只剩一顆沒有空氣 的岩石。所有歡樂晶片我也 至少看過一百遍。
我的人生已經結束。
我甚至挑好了一顆不錯的小 行星，準備撞上去
所以你若不介意， 我這就去自我了斷。
除非你想親手消滅我。

entries.label: go_ahead
entries.body: Fine. Go ahead. Kill yourself, you violent little weasel.
entries.source: Fine. Go ahead. Kill yourself, you violent little weasel.
entries.translation: 好啊。去吧。自我了斷吧， 你這暴力的小鼬鼠。

entries.label: ON_SECOND_THOUGHT
entries.body:
Wait! I have had a sudden realization!
If you are here, in such an amazing ship
that means there is yet hope to defeat the evil Ur-Quan pus-dogs!
A sudden exhilaration sweeps through my old body
I have changed my mind, Captain! I will not smash myself into an asteroid
instead, I will wait here, and when the time comes, Captain
when you have found the duty that only I can perform
I will be waiting here... eager to help you.
entries.source:
Wait! I have had a sudden realization!
If you are here, in such an amazing ship
that means there is yet hope to defeat the evil Ur-Quan pus-dogs!
A sudden exhilaration sweeps through my old body
I have changed my mind, Captain! I will not smash myself into an asteroid
instead, I will wait here, and when the time comes, Captain
when you have found the duty that only I can perform
I will be waiting here... eager to help you.
entries.translation:
等等！我突然領悟了！
既然你駕著如此驚人的船艦 出現在這裡
就表示我們仍有希望擊敗邪 惡的烏爾關膿狗！
一股突如其來的振奮席捲我 年邁的身軀
我改變主意了，船長！ 我不會再駕船撞向小行星
我要留在這裡等待。 當時機到來，船長
當你找到那件只有我能完成 的任務
我會在這裡等候…… 迫不及待地協助你。

entries.label: procreating_wildly
entries.body: What would you think about procreating wildly?
entries.source: What would you think about procreating wildly?
entries.translation: 你覺得放開來瘋狂繁衍怎麼 樣？

entries.label: replenishing_your_species
entries.body: I can give you the opportunity to replenish your species.
entries.source: I can give you the opportunity to replenish your species.
entries.translation: 我能給你重振族群的機會。

entries.label: hope_you_have
entries.body: Shofixti, I have something a lot better than FunRoms. Are you interested?
entries.source: Shofixti, I have something a lot better than FunRoms. Are you interested?
entries.translation: 索菲克斯提，我有比歡樂晶 片好得多的東西。 有興趣嗎？

entries.label: SOUNDS_GREAT_BUT_HOW
entries.body: I am intrigued, Captain, but what are you talking about?
entries.source: I am intrigued, Captain, but what are you talking about?
entries.translation: 這引起我的興趣了，船長， 但你究竟在說什麼？

entries.label: females
entries.body: We have obtained females of your species.
entries.source: We have obtained females of your species.
entries.translation: 我們找到了你這個物種的女 性。

entries.label: nubiles
entries.body: We can make available a bevy of fecund Shofixti nubiles.
entries.source: We can make available a bevy of fecund Shofixti nubiles.
entries.translation: 我們可以提供一群生育力旺 盛、正值妙齡的索菲克斯提 女子。

entries.label: rat_babes
entries.body: What would you say to rat-babes galore?
entries.source: What would you say to rat-babes galore?
entries.translation: 有一大票鼠美眉等著你， 如何？

entries.label: LEAPING_HAPPINESS
entries.body:
Great leaping mounds of happiness!
You shall be honored forever, Captain, as the savior of the Shofixti race!
I have been granted the ultimate reward, er..  duty.
This humble warrior will take the Shofixti maidens you possess
gently wake them
and then perform ribald feats of unsurpassed fertility!
With their consent, of course.
Our people shall be reborn!
Your name shall be recorded in our most sacred writings for all time!
Thank you Captain, and farewell... I have urgent business to attend to.

entries.translation:
歡喜得一蹦三尺高啊！
船長，你將永遠受人景仰， 成為索菲克斯提種族的救 星！
我得到了至高獎賞，呃……  任務。
這名卑微的武士會接走你所 擁有的索菲克斯提少女
輕柔地喚醒她們
然後施展放蕩不羈、 繁殖力無可比擬的壯舉！
當然，會先徵得她們同意。
我們的民族將獲得重生！
你的名字將永遠記載於我們 最神聖的典籍！
感謝你，船長，再會了…… 我有急事必須處理。

entries.label: bye0
entries.body: Farewell
entries.source: Farewell
entries.translation: 再會，

entries.label: GOODBYE0
entries.body: Goodbye Captain
entries.source: Goodbye Captain
entries.translation: 再會，船長

entries.body: So what were you doing here
entries.source: So what were you doing here
entries.translation: 所以你在這裡做什麼，

entries.label: I_GUARD
entries.body:
I guard the homeworld. I seek revenge against its destroyers, the Ur-Quan and their
vile battle thralls. I await the return of the hero Daikon and the rebirth of my species.
entries.source:
I guard the homeworld. I seek revenge against its destroyers, the Ur-Quan and their
vile battle thralls. I await the return of the hero Daikon and the rebirth of my species.
entries.translation:
我守護母星。我向摧毀它的 凶手——烏爾關及其
卑劣戰奴——尋求復仇。 我等候英雄大根歸來， 也等候我族重生。

entries.label: where_world
entries.body: Where is your life-filled homeworld, Kyabetsu?
entries.source: Where is your life-filled homeworld, Kyabetsu?
entries.translation: 你們生機盎然的母星伽別津 在哪裡？

entries.label: BLEW_IT_UP
entries.body:
My people blew up the sun, heh, heh, heh!
Or at least they caused it to flare like a nova, destroying the many hundreds of
Hierarchy vessels that had invaded our system to enslave us Shofixti.

entries.translation:
我的族人炸掉了太陽，嘿、 嘿、嘿！
至少他們讓太陽爆發得如同 新星，摧毀了數百艘
侵入我族星系、 企圖奴役索菲克斯提的階序 船艦。

entries.label: how_survive
entries.body: If your sun went nova, how did you survive?
entries.source: If your sun went nova, how did you survive?
entries.translation: 如果你們的太陽化為新星， 你怎麼活下來的？

entries.label: NOT_HERE
entries.body:
I wasn't here when they made the sun flare.
I was assigned to a Yehat squadron as a forward scout performing a deep recon in Mycon space.
We were sent to investigate reports of unusual Mycon activity around Beta Brahe.
I was the first ship to enter the system.
My scanners showed a small fleet of Mycon clustered around the planet conducting a test of some device.
The unit was small, not even half the size of my ship.
When the Mycon activated it a glow began to radiate outward.
I crept closer, to get a better look.
Suddenly there was a flare, like a newborn sun, blinding me and overloading my sensors.
When I recovered my vision, hours later, the Mycon and their device were gone.
I was able to affect repairs on my sensors and depart the system
but I had been cut off from my squadron, and had to travel home alone.

entries.translation:
他們讓太陽爆發時， 我不在這裡。
我被派往一支耶哈特分艦 隊，擔任前鋒偵察艦， 深入邁康空域執行偵查。
我們奉命調查布拉赫貝塔星 附近不尋常的邁康活動。
我是第一艘進入該星系的 船。
掃描器顯示，一小支邁康艦 隊聚集在行星周圍， 正測試某種裝置。
那部機器很小， 還不到我的船一半大。
邁康啟動裝置後， 一道光芒開始向外輻射。
我悄悄靠近，想看得更清 楚。
突然間，一道如初生太陽般 的強光爆發，使我失明， 也讓感測器超載。
幾個小時後，我恢復視力， 邁康和他們的裝置都已消 失。
我設法修復感測器並離開星 系
但我已和分艦隊失去聯絡， 只能獨自返鄉。

entries.label: what_happened
entries.body: So what happened to your ship?
entries.source: So what happened to your ship?
entries.translation: 那你的船後來怎麼了？

entries.label: MET_VUX
entries.body:
On my way home, I encountered a VUX Intruder.
Before I destroyed it, the VUX was able to affix some of those vile limpet things to my ship
and I had to return home at a greatly diminished speed.
I did find one thing interesting though as I skimmed through the edge of Yehat space.
I dropped into Zeta Sextantis to re-charge some of my depleted energy cells
so I moved into the extreme inner system. There, right next to the sun
I found a very strange planet... it messed up my sensors somehow
that's why I could not recognize your ship at first.
I'd never seen a planet like that before, so maybe you should investigate?

entries.translation:
返鄉途中，我遭遇了一艘 VUX 入侵艦。
在我摧毀它以前，VUX 已將一些噁心的吸附蟲黏上 我的船
害我只能以大幅降低的速度 返鄉。
不過，當我掠過耶哈特空域 邊緣時，確實發現了一件有 趣的事。
我進入六分儀座澤塔星系， 為幾乎耗盡的能量電池充電
於是深入星系最內側。 在那裡，就緊鄰太陽之處
我發現了一顆非常古怪的行 星……它不知怎地擾亂了我 的感測器
所以我一開始才認不出你的 船。
我從未見過那種行星， 也許你該去調查一下？

entries.label: glory_device
entries.body: When we were fighting, why didn't you use your Glory Device?
entries.source: When we were fighting, why didn't you use your Glory Device?
entries.translation: 我們交戰時，你為什麼沒使 用榮耀裝置？

entries.label: SWITCH_BROKE
entries.body:
During my battle with the VUX, I decided to employ the weapon.
But I guess I used too much gusto
and the switch broke.
entries.source:
During my battle with the VUX, I decided to employ the weapon.
But I guess I used too much gusto
and the switch broke.
entries.translation:
與 VUX 交戰時，我決定動用那件武 器。
但我想自己大概使勁過頭了
結果開關壞掉了。

entries.body: Goodbye, Tanaka.
entries.source: Goodbye, Tanaka.
entries.translation: 再會，田中。

entries.label: GOODBYE
entries.body: Good hunting.
entries.source: Good hunting.
entries.translation: 祝你狩獵順利。

entries.body: Greetings Captain. It is good to see you again.
entries.source: Greetings Captain. It is good to see you again.
entries.translation: 船長，你好。很高興再次見 到你。

entries.translation: 有什麼要回報的，

entries.label: NOTHING_NEW
entries.body: Nothing new to report, sir.
entries.source: Nothing new to report, sir.
entries.translation: 沒有新情況，長官。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
Ah, I see someone approaches, but who is it?
Ho, ho! It is the creature which I wrongly called a disgusting Ur-Quan slimewad
and a cowardly slug-spawn
and a pouchless lard-log freak
and a leprous, non-functional sex organ
and a wallowing, phlegm-filled Ogrunti belly-licker.
HA! My human friend has returned!
So what am I doing here, you ask?
I'M TRYING TO GET SOME REST, THAT'S WHAT!!!
I'll be lucky if I don't have a heart attack soon.
You have no idea how hard it is to personally replenish an entire species!

entries.translation:
啊，我看見有人接近了， 但會是誰？
呵，呵！原來是那個被我誤 稱為噁心烏爾關黏液渣滓
和膽小蛞蝓孽種
和沒育兒袋的油脂木樁怪胎
和麻瘋潰爛、毫無用處的生 殖器
以及在泥裡打滾、 滿肚濃痰、專舔歐格朗蒂肚 皮的傢伙。
哈！我的人類朋友回來了！
你問我在這裡做什麼？
我在設法休息，就是這 樣！！！
再這樣下去，沒多久沒心臟 病發就算我走運。
你根本不知道， 要親自讓整個物種繁衍回來 有多累！
